name: Self-Directed Queries Complexity / Minimum Teaching Set Size
details: For every nonempty finite binary concept class on a finite domain, $\mathrm{SDC}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{TS}_{\min}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: The survey theorem proves the stronger whole-domain bound $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}(\mathcal H)\le M_{\mathrm{sd}}(\mathcal H,X)$ by answering opposite to each prediction whenever feasible: the mistaken examples teach the final surviving concept. The catalogue parameter maximizes over domains and is at least the whole-domain value.
proof_source: CombinatorialParameters/main.tex, Theorem thm:selfdirected-teaching; recursive characterization le:tpd. Doliwa--Fan--Simon--Zilles Lemma 7 and Corollary 8(1) give the classical whole-domain comparisons.
